# `mutated-container-copy`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports metadata mutation of an explicitly typed standard-library container
copied from a field when neither value is otherwise observed.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

A reallocating method can move the copy's buffer while the original retains
stale length and capacity, losing the mutation or leaking storage.

## When it fires

The initializer must be exactly `owner.field`, the local type must name a known
container through an unshadowed `const std = @import("std")`, and every later
use of the local must be a known length- or allocation-changing method. If the
field is referenced again, the copy is consumed, the type is inferred, or any
expression is ambiguous, the rule stays silent.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

const State = struct { list: std.ArrayList(u8) };

fn use(self: *State) void {
    var copy: std.ArrayList(u8) = self.list;
    _ = copy.pop();
}
```
